title: Integrate diagnostics and support bundle into audit projection
purpose: Expose diagnostics and support bundle generation as read-only/operator projection flows with redacted audit evidence.
scope: Add support bundle projection over health, runtime config summary, audit excerpts, and run metadata.
Ensure bundle generation is read-only and deterministic.
Expose bundle manifest and hash for release replay.
deliverables: diagnostics/support bundle projection implementation or smoke design
implementation_steps: Add or design support bundle manifest projection.
Add fixtures for valid and secret-like diagnostics.
Ensure support bundle generation writes only to artifact output path and not runtime state.
Record evidence with bundle manifest hash and redaction report.
acceptance_criteria: Bundle generation is read-only with respect to runtime authority.
Secret-like fields are redacted or rejected.
Bundle links to run IDs and audit event ranges.
